overview_description.description:
FitnessAI is an application for iPhone that utilizes artificial intelligence to generate personalized weight lifting plans. The AI optimizes sets, reps, and weight for each exercise every time the user works out that is based on 5.9M workouts.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York, United States.
